deployment.U: Uniform over scores at least max score minus tau for the corresponding head
deployment.P: Restrict the same support to actions attaining its largest original train600 integer success count over three seeds. Use uniform probabilities over residual exact count ties.

cohort.source: Official GSM8K train and BBH test, pinned to the source frames used by P2
cohort.selection: Within each stratum sort lexicographically by SHA256 of UTF-8 seed|stratum|canonical_question_sha256. Take the first fixed quota. All quotas and identities precede encoder forward passes, scores, policy support and new rewards.

evaluation.unit: Original question with three paired generation records averaged within question
evaluation.primary_weights: GSM8K 0.5, each of 26 common BBH strata 0.5/26
evaluation.primary_test: One two-sided stratified paired mean test using Satterthwaite t and alpha=0.05
evaluation.point_reporting: Report four accuracies, primary I, both training gaps, both within-head deployment effects and their task and seed breakdown. Compare to the same 26-stratum weighting on historical E23 and retain original historical weighting separately.
evaluation.primary_evaluable_condition: All frozen required outputs have a definitive binary score on the same 1196 questions. A missing or unscorable row blocks the primary projection and triggers a separate data-quality ledger, with no replacement after score access.

diagnostics.score_tolerance_use: Input-only unique-winner counts. No alternative-tau outcome comparisons or generation expansion.
diagnostics.regions: Pre-score B-U singleton versus B-U multiple actions, with a supplementary both-singleton different-winner subset. Region contributions use full fixed stratum denominators. Members of this strict-switch subset have identical U and P choices for both heads.

cost.aggregation_support: For each question and generation seed evaluate the deduplicated B_U and C_U support union. Both P supports are subsets.
cost.member_support: Deduplicate each required combination to its distinct member-model calls within original question and generation seed.
cost.reuse: Credit verified caches only for identical original question identity, model, prompt, seed and scientific operator, with evidence of actual successful execution.
cost.token_accounting: Record input and output tokens, gold accounts, scorer calls, duplicate or failed native attempts and actual wall time separately.

scope: Freeze the independent input cohort, four policies and exact required call counts from zero for review before a separate physical inference start. Preserve sealed200 via prior identity exclusions and one-way fingerprints.
